entity.name: Samuel Davis
entity.description: I'm Sam Davis, the sole developer and maintainer of Crads-AI. I have a PhD in environmental data science from the University of Sydney, and I'm based in Sydney. I earn a living from services around it (guided setups and support), never from the software, which stays free.

projects.name: Crads-AI
projects.description: Free, open-source, self-hosted AI assistant infrastructure. A desktop app provisions a small cloud server in the user's own account (their own API token, their own SSH key) and connects to it. The server runs a persistent brain of plain Markdown files in git, backed up to the user's own private GitHub repo, plus a scheduler, skills, and Claude Code as the assistant working inside it, on the user's own Claude subscription. Nothing central: no accounts, billing or servers run by the project. Communities share skills and prompts through a plain git repository, and nothing shared runs on a member's server unless they install it. Public under AGPL-3.0 since September 2026.
